description.node_id: Unique identifier for this edge node (e.g., 'laptop-gpu', 'server-1')
description.poll_interval_sec: Time between measurements in seconds. Higher = less overhead but slower updates
description.backend_url: Base URL of the central monitoring backend (without /api/kpi/submit)
description.dry_run: If true, prints data locally instead of sending to backend. Use false for production
